native_editor_IRQ5_to_IRQ7.scope: Observe release of the old PIC bit during a real editor IRQ-only handoff. native_editor_paths.scope: Exercise PRMEDIT absolute identities, decoys and drive/CWD restoration in DOS. Synthetic PRM images, actual editor UI save, invalid paths refuse. No physical hardware claim.

native_editor_leaf_regressions.scope: Actual DOSBox-X filesystem and BIOS keyboard/video, synthetic settings only. UI host links identical UI source with renamed main to independently verify restoration; exact production EXE separately saves. No original PCSETUP, UART or physical hardware tests.

adoption_guards.scope: Check linked adoption adapters, persistent storage and actual refusal guards. Actual linked guards and four-word adapters execute or are inspected; only canonicalization would be modeled, and these cases perform none. Five damaged executables are inspected only. This is not a successful adoption, complete stack high-water, UART/connection or file-transfer proof; native application tests are separate.

native_selection_dial_script.scope: Apply a directory selection, change CWD, then dial and run its canonical script. Actual DOS8086 COM3/IRQ5 parent, compiler/ASPECT, real PROGRAM CD/COPY and DOSBox modem carrier model and a TCP BBS peer. Same-write CONNECT/banner and actual ANSI replies. No live BBS/SIP/DSP/analog/card acceptance.
